title: Application AuthProxy Entity
description: Common properties shared by all authentication proxy applications (OAuth2 Proxy, Authelia, Keycloak Gatekeeper).

listen_address.description: Address the auth proxy listens on.

listen_port.description: Port the auth proxy listens on.

upstream.description: URL of the protected upstream application.

cookie_secret_secret.description: Doorman secret reference for cookie encryption key.

cookie_secure.description: Whether the session cookie requires HTTPS.
